description: Defines a template class ResourceMap for managing resources with optimized storage, combining a flat array and an unordered map, including iterator support and resource management methods.

classes.name: ResourceMap
classes.description: A resource management class that uses a combination of a flat array and a hash map for efficient resource lookup and management.

classes.name: ResourceMap::Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing the ResourceMap.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the resource associated with the given ID, or nullptr if not found.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a resource with the given ID is reserved in the map.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes the resource with the specified ID from the map.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns a resource to a given ID in the map.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all resources from the map.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the map.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the map.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds the resource with the specified handle.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: nextNonNullResource
methods.description: Finds the next non-null resource starting from a given flat index.

methods.name: InvalidPointer
methods.description: Returns a static invalid pointer value.
